question: Ali Akbar Khan is associated with which of these instruments?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sarod.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ali Akbar Khan** is a renowned **musician and composer** from India, known for his mastery over the** Sarod.**
 
• The Sarod is a **stringed instrument** that is played with a** plectrum** and is popular in** Hindustani classical music.**
 
• The** Shehnai **is a **wind instrument** that is commonly played in **North Indian weddings** and other festive occasions.
 
• The **Tabla **is a **pair of hand drums **that are used in **Hindustani classical music **and are known for their** intricate rhythms.**
 
• The** Sitar** is a** stringed instrument **that is played by **plucking the strings** and is also commonly used in Hindustani classical music.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Sarod **is said to have been invented by **Ali Akbar Khan's father, Allauddin Khan.**
 
• **Shehnai** is a **wind instrument **that is commonly played in **North Indian weddings** and other festive occasions. 
 
 
• The Shehnai is often played in **pairs** and is known for its **high-pitched, nasal sound.**
 
 
 
• **The Tabla** consists of two drums, the smaller one called the **Dayan** and the larger one called the **Bayan.**
 
• The **Sitar** has **18-20 strings,** of which** 6-7** are played **melody strings** and the rest are drone strings.
 
 
• It is often associated with the** legendary musician, Ravi Shankar.**
